detail.longDescription: How practical is a fully local AI agent on an Android phone today? ​With modern small LLMs (1B - 4B parameters, 4-bit quantization), we get complete offline privacy. But when it comes to reliable tool calling, multi-step planning, and battery/thermal constraints is on-device agentic AI genuinely useful for daily workflows yet, or still mostly a tech demo? ​What are your thoughts or real-world experiences with edge models on mobile? # OnDeviceAI # EdgeAI # LLM # OpenSource # MachineLearning # SLM # ai # android # aiagents
